cards.name: 德國
cards.scene: A cheerful child tourist standing in front of a fairy-tale European castle on a green hill in Germany, holding a small flag with plain black, red and gold horizontal stripes.

cards.name: 似乎
cards.scene: A child standing outside looking up at gathering grey clouds, holding one hand out palm up, with an unsure, wondering face as if it seems about to rain.

cards.name: 血液
cards.scene: A friendly simple diagram-style illustration of a transparent tube (blood vessel) with round red blood cells flowing through it, next to a smiling child showing a small bandage on the arm.

cards.name: 拍攝
cards.scene: A photographer sitting at the open door of a helicopter, holding a big video camera and filming green mountains, rivers and fields far below.

cards.name: 颱風
cards.scene: A strong typhoon: palm trees bending in heavy wind and rain, swirling dark clouds, a child in a yellow raincoat holding an umbrella that is turned inside out.

cards.name: 記錄
cards.scene: A child carefully drawing pictures of a sprouting bean plant in a notebook while watching the potted plant on the table; the notebook shows only simple drawings of the plant.

cards.name: 哀愁
cards.scene: A man looking sadly out of a helicopter window at a hillside where many trees have been cut down and a muddy brown river below, a sorrowful face.

cards.name: 山巒
cards.scene: Layer after layer of rolling green mountain ranges one behind another, soft mist between them, a small child on a hilltop looking at the view.

cards.name: 縱谷
cards.scene: A long, deep green valley between two parallel mountain ranges, with a river and rice fields running down the middle, seen from above.

cards.name: 臍帶
cards.scene: A gentle, cute illustration of a smiling pregnant mother touching her belly, with a simple drawing of a baby inside connected to her by a soft cord. Warm, gentle, not medical.

cards.name: 人禍
cards.scene: Workers cutting down many trees on a hillside with saws, and mud starting to slide down the bare slope; a worried child watching from below. Not scary.

cards.name: 殘破
cards.scene: An old broken-down house with holes in the roof, broken windows, and cracked walls, weeds growing around it.

cards.name: 檳榔
cards.scene: Tall slim betel nut palm trees with bunches of green betel nuts hanging under the leaves, on a hillside.

cards.name: 降低
cards.scene: A thermometer with the red line going down (no numbers or marks on it), snowflakes around, and a child putting on a warm sweater and scarf.

cards.name: 汙水
cards.scene: A pipe pouring dark dirty water into a river, the river water turning black, a sad fish swimming away.

cards.name: 不斷
cards.scene: A leaky faucet dripping water drops one after another, nonstop, into a bucket that is filling up.

cards.name: 無聲無息
cards.scene: Snowflakes falling quietly at night on a sleeping little village, soft moonlight, everything calm and silent.

cards.name: 林立
cards.scene: A big city with many tall skyscrapers standing close together like trees in a forest, seen from a helicopter.

cards.name: 子子孫孫
cards.scene: A big happy family standing together: great-grandparents, grandparents, parents and small children, four generations, smiling.

cards.name: 腳踏實地
cards.scene: A child with a backpack walking step by step on a dirt path, leaving clear footprints, steady and determined, looking forward.

cards.name: 德高望重
cards.scene: A kind old teacher with white hair smiling, surrounded by students who are bowing to him respectfully.

cards.name: 微乎其微
cards.scene: A child looking through a magnifying glass at one tiny ant on a very large green leaf, showing how extremely small it is.

cards.name: 哀鴻遍野
cards.scene: A flock of wild geese flying low and crying sadly over a flooded village where people sit on rooftops wrapped in blankets. Gentle, not graphic.

cards.name: 抱殘守缺
cards.scene: An old man tightly hugging a broken old radio and shaking his head, refusing the shiny new radio that a child offers him.

cards.name: 同流合汙
cards.scene: Two naughty kids secretly picking apples from someone else's tree and waving for a third kid to join them; the third kid hesitates.

cards.name: 當機立斷
cards.scene: A hiking leader on a mountain trail seeing dark storm clouds coming, quickly pointing back down the mountain; the hikers turn around right away.

cards.name: 平原
cards.scene: A wide flat green plain with rice fields stretching to the horizon, a straight road across it, and a child riding a bicycle.

cards.name: 震懾
cards.scene: A big tiger roaring loudly on a rock, and small forest animals frozen in fear, not daring to move. Cute style, not scary.

cards.name: 忙碌
cards.scene: A busy worker carrying heavy stones back and forth at a construction site, sweating, with many tasks around.

cards.name: 俸祿
cards.scene: An ancient Chinese official in traditional robes receiving a small bag of coins and a sack of rice as his salary.

cards.name: 綠葉
cards.scene: A branch full of fresh bright green leaves in spring, a child touching one leaf happily.

cards.name: 衷心
cards.scene: A child with one hand on the heart, bowing and sincerely thanking a smiling teacher.

cards.name: 衰弱
cards.scene: A weak, tired old grandfather lying in bed with a blanket, a family member gently giving him warm soup.

cards.name: 孿生
cards.scene: Two identical twin sisters with the same face, same hairstyle and same clothes, holding hands and smiling.

cards.name: 欒樹
cards.scene: A Taiwanese golden rain tree (koelreuteria) with clusters of yellow flowers and pinkish-red seed pods, along a sidewalk.

cards.name: 肚臍
cards.scene: A cute smiling baby lying on a blanket, showing a round tummy with a little belly button.

cards.name: 擁擠
cards.scene: A very crowded subway car packed with many people standing close together, a small child squeezed in the middle.

cards.name: 救濟
cards.scene: Volunteers handing out boxes of food and bottles of water to people who lost their homes after a flood.

cards.name: 車禍
cards.scene: Two small cars that bumped into each other on a road with minor dents, the drivers standing safely beside them, a traffic police officer coming. No injuries.

cards.name: 飯鍋
cards.scene: A metal rice cooker pot with the lid open, full of steaming white rice, a rice paddle beside it.

cards.name: 蝸牛
cards.scene: A snail with a spiral shell slowly crawling on a wet green leaf after rain, a child watching closely.

cards.name: 踐踏
cards.scene: A careless shoe stepping on flowers and grass in a park, and a child pointing and asking him to stop.

cards.name: 湖濱
cards.scene: A child and a parent walking along a path beside a calm lake at sunset, the water reflecting the orange sky.

cards.name: 投降
cards.scene: Cartoon toy soldiers raising a plain white flag and putting down their toy weapons, surrendering. Playful and gentle.
